findings.statement: CA9 is tumor-cell intrinsic: RCC cells hold 0.976 of tumor transcripts (54.7% of RCC cells express it), and tumor cells vs proximal tubule give log2FC 7.739 (padj 0.0189, 6 donors). Bulk RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 7.787, so the signal is not infiltration.

In Visium, high-CA9 spots are explained by RCC (composition-corrected share 0.999) and their ring-1 neighbours are enriched for RCC (log2 enrichment 0.381, padj 0.0017; observed 0.4757 vs expected 0.3654), i.e. CA9 marks tumor-cell-rich niches.

The best CA9 site for a molecular glue degrader scores 0.546 (volume 126.8 A3, pocket pLDDT 90.3, one accessible lysine); model mean pLDDT is 76.56. Ligand-site recall is 0.5 (recall in top pockets 0.221), so this is a modest, small-pocket site and no glue is implied.

CD70 ranks 3 in convergence (score 4.2143), with TCGA log2FC 7.09 and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 4.278, which supports tumor-intrinsic up-regulation. Existing clinical-stage agents (e.g. vorsetuzumab mafodotin, phase 1) make it a repurposing rather than novel target.
NNMT is tumor-intrinsic: RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 5.256 and TCGA log2FC 4.685; it carries adverse prognosis (Cox log HR 0.301) and has no clinical drug in the graph. Rank 7 in convergence.

ALDOB ranks 2 in convergence but is a loss marker: TCGA log2FC -4.741 and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of -6.302, consistent with loss of proximal-tubule identity. It is a biomarker, not a target to inhibit.
SLC22A8 is a down-regulated proximal-tubule biomarker (TCGA log2FC -6.154; RNA log2FC at purity 1 -5.787) with favourable prognosis when high (Cox log HR -0.402).

KDR transcripts are endothelial: 0.951 of tumor transcripts and 40.5% of endothelial cells express it. It is a microenvironment (anti-angiogenic) target, not a tumor-cell one; bulk RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 1.502.
CD74 is immune: macrophages carry 0.436 of tumor transcripts (99.5% expressing) and cDC have the highest per-cell level (cpm_share 0.311, 100% expressing). It is not a tumor-cell target.

In situ, high-CD74 spots are explained mostly by macrophages (composition-corrected share 0.637, RCC 0.159) and neighbours are enriched for T cells (log2 enrichment 0.388) and macrophages (0.218), padj 0.0017.

CXCR4 is lymphoid: CD8 T cells carry 0.563 of tumor transcripts (72.9% expressing) and CD4 T cells have the highest per-cell level (87.8% expressing, cpm_share 0.17). Immune-cell target, not tumor-cell.
MET is mostly tumor-cell: RCC cells hold 0.935 of tumor transcripts (35.2% expressing), with endothelium a minor second site (12% expressing, cpm_share 0.283).

EPAS1 (HIF-2a) transcripts are mainly non-tumor in this scRNA dataset: endothelium holds 0.365 of transcripts (81.3% expressing) versus RCC 0.051 (4.9% expressing). Bulk EPAS1 signal therefore is not simply tumor-cell RNA.

Tumor-track discovery candidate (hypothesis): COL23A1 is carried by RCC cells (0.881 of transcripts), with 7 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, AB/PR tractable, surface or secreted, and low vital-organ expression (3 nTPM, heart muscle). TCGA log2FC 5.829 and log2FC at purity 1 4.88. Caveat: DepMap mean effect 0.167, no dependency evidence; literature counted by gene symbol.
The COL23A1 AlphaFold model is poor for glue design: mean pLDDT 58.91 and a single 8.0 A3 pocket with MGD score 0.2342. Not a credible MGD site.

Tumor-track hypothesis: RAB42 sits in RCC cells (0.627 of transcripts), has 2 ccRCC papers and no clinical drug, vital-organ max 2.6 nTPM (lung), TCGA log2FC 4.371 and log2FC at purity 1 3.189. Best site scores 0.5348 (37.4 A3, mean pLDDT 85.31, 3 accessible lysines), a small pocket with no ligand validation. Caveat: no dependency evidence (DepMap -0.075).

Stroma-track hypothesis: OLFML2A is fibroblast-borne (0.647 of transcripts), 2 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, antibody-tractable, but vital-organ expression is 27.9 nTPM (colon). TCGA log2FC 2.372, log2FC at purity 1 1.527. Caveat: stromal target, no functional evidence.

Stroma-track hypothesis: JAG2 is mostly endothelial (0.487 of transcripts), 9 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, vital-organ 12.7 nTPM (heart muscle). TCGA log2FC 1.549, purity-1 log2FC 1.061, Cox log HR -0.177 (not adverse). Caveat: modest effect size, no dependency evidence.

Immune-track hypothesis: GAL3ST4 is macrophage-borne (0.972 of transcripts), 1 ccRCC paper, no clinical drug, antibody-tractable, 7.4 nTPM in cerebral cortex. TCGA log2FC 2.993, purity-1 log2FC 0.401, adverse prognosis (Cox log HR 0.177). Caveat: purity-1 effect small, so mostly tumor-associated macrophage abundance; no dependency evidence.

Immune-track candidate flagged as infiltration-driven: LILRB4 is macrophage-borne (0.933 of transcripts) with TCGA log2FC 3.7 but purity-1 log2FC only 0.508 (purity_robust false), so the bulk signal largely reflects macrophage infiltration. 7 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug recorded.

caveats: Discovery candidates are data-ranked hypotheses with no dependency or functional evidence; literature is counted by gene symbol.
MGD scores rank sites only; small pockets and absent ligand-site validation (COL23A1, RAB42) weaken them; no glue is shown to exist.
Several cell groups have few cells or donors (PT 39 cells, endothelium 5 donors, Epi_other 18 cells), so per-group percentages are imprecise.
CD70 single-cell values were not citable (no evidence id returned), so only convergence-row values are quoted.
